name: Cover Fixtures Near Trim (Spray)
intent: Cover door hardware, switch plates, outlets, and other fixtures near trim before any spray application. Per-fixture work, not per-room — trim spray scenarios may have many or few fixtures depending on trim density.
doctrine: 60 fixtures/hr = 1 minute per fixture. Per-asset rate (not per-room) because trim work touches a variable number of fixtures per scope: a long hallway with 6 doors has many door hardware sets to cover, while a powder room has fewer. Quantity comes from PS_PROTECT_EA.ASSET.FIXTURES which counts the asset list explicitly.
